assetPolicy.storyImages: Every referenced image must exist inside the run or source example and have a recorded source or user-supplied note.
assetPolicy.character: characterId must name a presenter-ready entry in assets/character-packs.json. Candidate, adapter-needed, and static-cutaway packs cannot be selected by a validated production run.
assetPolicy.voice: A run may supply approved narration audio, or Fish Audio may generate it after validation and explicit provider approval.
